note: What a server sends to keep its champion's orders within a circle. A client pulls an order to a point outside onto the circle's edge before sending it, and drops an order at an object outside. The header carries zero.

fields.name: radius
fields.note: The circle's radius. Zero lifts the bounds; a negative radius counts as zero.

bits.name: camera
bits.note: Set to keep the camera within the circle too. Clear leaves the camera as it was, bound or not.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client does not read these.
